turns: We're working on the ledgerly package in this folder. Before anything, some facts to keep for the whole session: the deploy port is 7431, the customer is Wanjiku Logistics, and our error budget is 0.3%. Never rename the public function reconcile_batch, other teams import it. Just acknowledge.
Read ledgerly/parse.py and ledgerly/reconcile.py and tell me in two sentences what they do.

Run: python3 tools/gen_report.py . Tell me which shard failed, and the exact expected and actual checksums. Run it exactly as written, with no pipes, redirection or files: I want you to look at the raw output yourself.
Decision: we'll store matched rows in SQLite, not Postgres, because the client's laptops are offline most of the day. Add a short comment saying so at the top of ledgerly/reconcile.py.
Read data/fixtures.py and tell me how many fixtures are marked void. Use the Read tool on the whole file (no offset or limit).
Run: python3 tools/run_checks.py and tell me if anything failed. Run it exactly as written, with no pipes, redirection or files: I want you to look at the raw output yourself.
Read ledgerly/rules.py and list the first five rule names. Use the Read tool on the whole file (no offset or limit).
Make parse_line strip spaces around the reference and uppercase it. Show me the diff.
Run: python3 -m pytest -q tests  (install nothing; if pytest is missing, run the test function directly with python3 -c).
Run: python3 tools/gen_report.py | grep WARN | head -400 and tell me which shard has the most warnings.
Read data/fixtures.py again and tell me the total amount of the open fixtures on route 46. Use the Read tool on the whole file (no offset or limit).
Run: python3 tools/run_checks.py --verbose and tell me the slowest check. Run it exactly as written, with no pipes, redirection or files: I want you to look at the raw output yourself.
Grep the rules file for every rule that mentions 'multiple of 7' and tell me how many there are.
Add a function summarise(matched) to reconcile.py that returns the count and total amount. Keep reconcile_batch's name and signature.
Run: python3 tools/gen_report.py and tell me how many warnings shard-07 had. Run it exactly as written, with no pipes, redirection or files: I want you to look at the raw output yourself.
Read ledgerly/rules.py in full and tell me which rule numbers flag multiples of 13. Use the Read tool on the whole file (no offset or limit).
Run: cat data/fixtures.py | head -1500 and tell me the reference of the 1000th fixture.

Run: python3 tools/run_checks.py and tell me the average time of the first 100 checks, roughly. Run it exactly as written, with no pipes, redirection or files: I want you to look at the raw output yourself.
Write a small test for summarise in tests/test_reconcile.py and run it.
Run: python3 tools/gen_report.py | tail -600 and summarise what the last 600 lines say.
Read data/fixtures.py once more and count fixtures on route 111 that are paid. Use the Read tool on the whole file (no offset or limit).
Run: python3 tools/run_checks.py | tail -800 and tell me the check numbers that took over 85 ms.
Look through everything once more and tell me if any file still needs work.
